text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This year's Tenno Sho (Autumn) was hailed 
as the ultimate showdown between Oguri Cap 
and Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A clash between extraordinary talents. To 
compete on that stage, she might still be 
lacking in every single way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet, if she was to become Maruzensky's 
rival, Sakura Chiyono O could not afford 
to lose, no matter who stood before her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Maruzensky was paying a visit 
to Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While somewhere in her heart, hoping for 
the future Sakura Chiyono O was trying to 
show her.
